title: Flat Dimensions World Preset
description: Enables the “Flat All Dimensions” world preset ✨
body:
In version **26.2 - Chaos Cubed Drop 🟨🟥**, Minecraft added a new world preset called **"Flat All Dimensions" ✨**

But for some reason, it’s unavailable by default :/

This datapack restores the preset in-game, allowing you to explore a mysterious world where all dimensions generate as flat worlds.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7cccdf9867278010b4bf14ca33b5ee6319bfaaf3_0.webp)

**Enjoy 🔥**
